source: Weller et al., Solid State Ionics 175 (2004) 409-413, Fig.2a, printed p411
image_interpretation: Native embedded raster. x increases right; image y increases downward. Axis lettering is separate PDF text and is verified on the full page.
method: Manual tracing of curve/marker centers in the original raster, audited by overlay. Linear interpolation in the original 1000/T, ln(sigma*T) coordinates, no global Arrhenius fitting.
anchor_semantics: Manually selected curve-center coordinates; not claimed to be author raw measurement coordinates. Extra anchors at overlapping high-T symbols follow the visible connecting line and carry conservative pixel-reading bounds.

exclusion_record.reason: Outside requested 5.8-14.3mol% range; distinct low-doping polycrystal not used as a 5.8mol% substitute.
Outside requested range; farther than 15.7mol% from the highest requested composition.

forbidden_extrapolation: 1600K not digitized as measured data; no composition interpolation is performed.
